CREATE TABLE `artst` (
  `artst_id` int NOT NULL,
  `artst_nm` varchar(60) NOT NULL,
  `genre` varchar(20) DEFAULT NULL,
  `ctry` char(2) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT 'ISO country code',
  PRIMARY KEY (`artst_id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci COMMENT='Artists';

CREATE TABLE `cust` (
  `cust_id` int NOT NULL,
  `fname` varchar(40) NOT NULL,
  `lname` varchar(40) NOT NULL,
  `email` varchar(80) DEFAULT NULL,
  `city` varchar(40) DEFAULT NULL,
  `reg_dt` date DEFAULT NULL COMMENT 'Registration date',
  PRIMARY KEY (`cust_id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci COMMENT='Customers';

CREATE TABLE `evt` (
  `evt_id` int NOT NULL,
  `evt_nm` varchar(80) NOT NULL,
  `vnu_id` int NOT NULL,
  `artst_id` int NOT NULL,
  `evt_dt` datetime NOT NULL COMMENT 'Event start date and time',
  `base_prc` decimal(8,2) NOT NULL COMMENT 'Base ticket price in USD',
  PRIMARY KEY (`evt_id`),
  KEY `vnu_id` (`vnu_id`),
  KEY `artst_id` (`artst_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `evt_ibfk_1` FOREIGN KEY (`vnu_id`) REFERENCES `vnu` (`vnu_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `evt_ibfk_2` FOREIGN KEY (`artst_id`) REFERENCES `artst` (`artst_id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci COMMENT='Events';

CREATE TABLE `tkt` (
  `tkt_id` int NOT NULL,
  `ord_id` int NOT NULL,
  `evt_id` int NOT NULL,
  `seat_cls` varchar(5) NOT NULL COMMENT 'GEN or VIP',
  `prc` decimal(8,2) NOT NULL COMMENT 'Price paid for the ticket in USD',
  PRIMARY KEY (`tkt_id`),
  KEY `ord_id` (`ord_id`),
  KEY `evt_id` (`evt_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `tkt_ibfk_1` FOREIGN KEY (`ord_id`) REFERENCES `tkt_ord` (`ord_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `tkt_ibfk_2` FOREIGN KEY (`evt_id`) REFERENCES `evt` (`evt_id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci COMMENT='Tickets sold';

CREATE TABLE `tkt_ord` (
  `ord_id` int NOT NULL,
  `cust_id` int NOT NULL,
  `ord_dt` datetime NOT NULL,
  `pay_mthd` varchar(10) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT 'CARD, CASH or PAYPAL',
  `sts` varchar(10) NOT NULL COMMENT 'PAID or REFUNDED',
  PRIMARY KEY (`ord_id`),
  KEY `cust_id` (`cust_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `tkt_ord_ibfk_1` FOREIGN KEY (`cust_id`) REFERENCES `cust` (`cust_id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci COMMENT='Ticket orders';

CREATE TABLE `vnu` (
  `vnu_id` int NOT NULL,
  `vnu_nm` varchar(60) NOT NULL COMMENT 'Venue name',
  `city` varchar(40) NOT NULL,
  `cap` int NOT NULL COMMENT 'Maximum capacity',
  PRIMARY KEY (`vnu_id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci COMMENT='Venues';
farmacia:
CREATE TABLE `categorias` (
  `id_categoria` int NOT NULL,
  `nombre` varchar(40) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id_categoria`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci COMMENT='Categorías de producto';

CREATE TABLE `detalle_venta` (
  `id_venta` int NOT NULL,
  `id_producto` int NOT NULL,
  `cantidad` int NOT NULL,
  `precio_unitario` decimal(8,2) NOT NULL COMMENT 'Precio cobrado por unidad en esa venta',
  PRIMARY KEY (`id_venta`,`id_producto`),
  KEY `id_producto` (`id_producto`),
  CONSTRAINT `detalle_venta_ibfk_1` FOREIGN KEY (`id_venta`) REFERENCES `ventas` (`id_venta`),
  CONSTRAINT `detalle_venta_ibfk_2` FOREIGN KEY (`id_producto`) REFERENCES `productos` (`id_producto`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci COMMENT='Productos incluidos en cada venta';

CREATE TABLE `empleados` (
  `id_empleado` int NOT NULL,
  `nombre` varchar(40) NOT NULL,
  `apellido` varchar(40) NOT NULL,
  `id_sucursal` int NOT NULL,
  `puesto` varchar(30) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT 'cajero, farmaceutico o gerente',
  `salario` decimal(10,2) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT 'Salario mensual en quetzales',
  `fecha_ingreso` date DEFAULT NULL,
  `id_jefe` int DEFAULT NULL COMMENT 'Empleado al que reporta; NULL si no tiene jefe',
  PRIMARY KEY (`id_empleado`),
  KEY `id_sucursal` (`id_sucursal`),
  KEY `id_jefe` (`id_jefe`),
  CONSTRAINT `empleados_ibfk_1` FOREIGN KEY (`id_sucursal`) REFERENCES `sucursales` (`id_sucursal`),
  CONSTRAINT `empleados_ibfk_2` FOREIGN KEY (`id_jefe`) REFERENCES `empleados` (`id_empleado`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci;

CREATE TABLE `productos` (
  `id_producto` int NOT NULL,
  `nombre` varchar(80) NOT NULL,
  `id_categoria` int NOT NULL,
  `id_proveedor` int NOT NULL,
  `precio` decimal(8,2) NOT NULL COMMENT 'Precio de venta al público en quetzales',
  `requiere_receta` tinyint(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT '0' COMMENT '1 si necesita receta médica',
  PRIMARY KEY (`id_producto`),
  KEY `id_categoria` (`id_categoria`),
  KEY `id_proveedor` (`id_proveedor`),
  CONSTRAINT `productos_ibfk_1` FOREIGN KEY (`id_categoria`) REFERENCES `categorias` (`id_categoria`),
  CONSTRAINT `productos_ibfk_2` FOREIGN KEY (`id_proveedor`) REFERENCES `proveedores` (`id_proveedor`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci;

CREATE TABLE `proveedores` (
  `id_proveedor` int NOT NULL,
  `nombre` varchar(60) NOT NULL,
  `pais` varchar(40) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT 'País de origen del proveedor',
  PRIMARY KEY (`id_proveedor`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci;

CREATE TABLE `sucursales` (
  `id_sucursal` int NOT NULL,
  `nombre` varchar(60) NOT NULL,
  `ciudad` varchar(40) NOT NULL,
  `fecha_apertura` date DEFAULT NULL COMMENT 'Fecha en que abrió la sucursal',
  PRIMARY KEY (`id_sucursal`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci COMMENT='Sucursales de la cadena de farmacias';

CREATE TABLE `ventas` (
  `id_venta` int NOT NULL,
  `id_sucursal` int NOT NULL,
  `id_empleado` int NOT NULL COMMENT 'Empleado que registró la venta',
  `fecha` datetime NOT NULL,
  `metodo_pago` varchar(15) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT 'efectivo, tarjeta o transferencia',
  PRIMARY KEY (`id_venta`),
  KEY `id_sucursal` (`id_sucursal`),
  KEY `id_empleado` (`id_empleado`),
  CONSTRAINT `ventas_ibfk_1` FOREIGN KEY (`id_sucursal`) REFERENCES `sucursales` (`id_sucursal`),
  CONSTRAINT `ventas_ibfk_2` FOREIGN KEY (`id_empleado`) REFERENCES `empleados` (`id_empleado`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci COMMENT='Encabezado de cada venta';
